text:
I'm sorry, I know it's frustrating to see a charge right after cancelling.

Plant Club is charged on the **25th** of the month before the box ships. Your $49 Collector charge was most likely taken on the 25th, a day before you cancelled. Under our policy:

- Changes made on or after the 25th apply to the **following** month's box, so your cancellation stops future charges but not this one.
- An already-billed box **isn't refunded** on cancellation and is still sent. It will ship in the first full week of the month.

So I can't refund this charge under the policy. Your cancellation has no fee or minimum term, and you won't be billed again.

Because it's a live plant, it can't be returned for change of mind. If it arrives damaged, report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. Otherwise, the normal Plant Care Guarantee applies.

If your statement shows the charge was taken **after** you cancelled, or you think there's been an error, I can escalate this to a Support Lead to review. Just tell me the date on the charge. Please don't send any card details.
